frozen_at: before new evaluation cases or their simulation outcomes were exposed

primary_endpoint.description: Four simultaneous loaded feet on FL5 FR5 RL3 RR3 continuously for 0.5 s; >=1 N upward foot contact each
primary_endpoint.strict_mission: Installed closed passive 10 Nm valve, physical opening to 90 +/- 0.25 deg for 5 s, gripper release and a further 5 s standing; apply published manipulation and walking limits.

clock: Report original 19.96 s and extended horizon up to 150 s separately. Within each comparison, use exactly the same start, model, actuator limits, geometry, termination, horizon and task criteria. The original actor stair scene has a fixed arm; test valve completion separately on the articulated task model.
attribution: Freeze controller and catalog before decryption/reveal. Source-bound original agent decision, log real inputs, predeclared contrasts including same catalog best fixed on development and no evidence/teacher-only where relevant. A matched best fixed result does not establish a model-specific advantage. Record demonstration or planner assistance and actor intervention magnitude/ablation separately.

criterion.signed_paired_test: exact two-sided; report paired uncertainty, failed cohorts and number of attempts
criterion.confirmation: After any positive holdout run, repeat frozen successful method on the independently committed untouched confirmation block.

development: Previous data are visible. Never reuse an opened test block for new efficacy claims. No selection from test outcomes.
